reasons: Claimed status is compliant and no redline or comment was proposed, which is the expected output for a compliant finding.

The cited paragraphs support the conclusion: §12.2(a)(i) permits Sanofi (our side) to terminate for convenience on notice alone with no break fee or minimum spend, and §12.3(c) consequences are reversion/transition plus royalties flowing to us, not stipulated damages against us.
§9.6 is ordinary late-payment interest capped at the maximum permitted by Applicable Law, which the rule's detection guidance does not treat as a Customer-payable liquidated damage or penalty.

§12.6 is a mutual general-remedies preservation clause with no stipulated amount; the rationale correctly notes it as an observation rather than a deviation, consistent with the playbook's treatment of minor sub-elements.
Deterministic checks are empty and the redline text is identical to the originals, confirming no unnecessary edits were made.
